fixer.title: Chat input pills: only rescan the row when its state changes

introducer.title: Chat: unify Agent Host status pills across chat surfaces

cases.mechanism: Every live pill-source update invoked synchronous scrollbar geometry reads even when row visibility/emptiness was unchanged, multiplying layout work by streaming update count.
cases.symptom: Streaming an agent response caused hundreds of unnecessary row rescans and dozens of forced layouts, adding measurable main-thread layout time.
cases.fixedBehavior: The added autorun reads a separately derived scalar rowState. Derived uses strict equality and only notifies the autorun when that state changes, so source updates that merely alter pill data no longer execute DOM class updates or scanDomNode. Actual pill size changes remain covered by ChatPillsRow's ResizeObserver, while visibility-state transitions still scan once.
cases.evidence: Base line 534 called ChatPillsRow.scanDomNode from a derived(...).recomputeInitiallyAndOnChange callback. Observable KeepAliveObserver invokes that callback at the end of every dependency update, regardless of whether the derived 'visible'/'empty'/'hidden' value changed. AgentHostSessionInputPills feeds ChatInputPills from live session/chat subscriptions and derived artifact/reference/change sources, so streaming state updates repeatedly reached this callback. ChatPillsRow.scanDomNode delegates to DomScrollableElement.scanDomNode, which synchronously reads clientWidth, scrollWidth, clientHeight, and scrollHeight. The PR's layout probe reports 320 rescans, 43 forced layouts, and 52 ms over one streamed response, matching the traced mechanism.
